fastMonthlyBasis: cohort fast tier mean x 45/day x 30
rationale: Heavy measured on 9 dispatches of heavy | vercel/openai/gpt-6.1-terra#xhigh at a mean of $0.041739 (median $0.037107).
Validation factor is 1 because validationStatus is "not-needed": no invoice was available, so the projection is the unadjusted local estimate.
p90 is the maximum observation (n<10), not a 90th percentile.
Fast costs about $4.7168/month at 45/day, which the spec assumed was free.
The band is keep-terra-xhigh on the interval [7.8594,15.4533], not on the point estimate.
Scope was reduced to 15/15/9 from 45/39/9 by explicit approval; heavy kept its n because it is the decision input.

smallSample.note: With n<10 the p90 is the largest observation. The interval, not the point estimate, carries the band.
